newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cattle group welcomes new USDA price reports.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cattle group welcomes new USDA price reports.

text.p: The U.S. National Cattlemen's Beef Association said Wednesday it welcomed the Agriculture Department's new weekly cattle price reports.
"The value grid and forward contracts of slaughter cattle reports will provide producers improved market information and will promote competition in the marketplace," NCBA said in a statement.
The reports by USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service were started in response to the recommendations of the agency's advisory committee on agricultural concentration.

The forward contract report provides price information based on the futures price for the month that cattle are scheduled for delivery, as well as the number of reported slaughter cattle contracted for the week.
The value grid report provides premium and discount information reflecting adjustments to the base carcass price for quality grade, yield grade and weight.
The information is reported voluntarily by packers.
